ITEM 1 | Dark red-brown kidney-shaped beans, glossy and smooth-skinned, scattered throughout the bowl, roughly 1.5 cm long each, about 20 visible beans with some partly hidden under greens | 60
ITEM 2 | Bright green broccoli florets with compact tops and thick pale-green stems, roughly 2-4 cm across, scattered around the bowl edges and center, slightly glossy and firm | 75
ITEM 3 | Pale off-white cooked chicken pieces, irregular chunks about 1.5-2.5 cm, slightly fibrous with a matte surface and a few browned edges, scattered over the greens and beans | 45
ITEM 4 | Thin translucent pale shavings, off-white to cream, flat and slightly curled, sitting on top of the chicken and greens, possibly a hard cheese | 8
ITEM 5 | Mixed salad greens in dark red-purple and bright green frilly leaves, some wilted and glossy, lying flat across the bowl base and between other ingredients | 40
